services.name: General Health Checkup
services.shortDescription: Our signature comprehensive health screening designed to evaluate overall wellness, baseline vitals, metabolic markers, and preventive health status.
services.description: The General Health Checkup at PR HEALTH CARE provides a detailed, proactive evaluation of your overall health. Our clinical team checks critical physiological markers including blood pressure, pulse rate, oxygen saturation, body mass index, and blood glucose. The assessment concludes with an actionable consultation outlining preventive recommendations, dietary balance, and lifestyle adjustments tailored to your profile.
features: Complete vital sign assessment (BP, Heart Rate, Pulse Oximetry, BMI)
Head-to-toe baseline physical and systemic examination
One-on-one lifestyle and preventive health consultation
Comprehensive health summary report for your personal records

services.name: General Consultation
services.shortDescription: In-depth clinical evaluation for acute illnesses, fevers, seasonal infections, digestive issues, chronic pain, and routine medical concerns.
services.description: Whether you are experiencing unexpected fever, respiratory symptoms, aches, gastrointestinal discomfort, or require a thorough medical opinion, our General Consultation offers attentive clinical diagnosis. We take the time to evaluate your medical history, perform focused physical checks, and prescribe targeted medical treatments.
features: Focused symptom examination and clinical history review
Investigation recommendations (lab tests/imaging) only if clinically required
Clear post-consultation recovery guidance and follow-up plan

services.name: Preventive Healthcare
services.shortDescription: Proactive risk profiling, lifestyle modifications, and immunization guidance to identify and mitigate health risks before they develop.
services.description: Preventive Healthcare is the cornerstone of lifelong wellness. Through structured risk profiling, we assess family medical history, cardiovascular risk factors, metabolic health indicators, and lifestyle stressors. We then craft individualized health roadmaps that help you avert common lifestyle illnesses.
features: Cardiovascular and metabolic risk factor evaluation
Individualized nutrition, stress, and physical exercise counseling
Adult immunization and vaccination schedule guidance
Periodic preventive checkup intervals based on age and history

services.name: Basic Health Assessment
services.shortDescription: Essential biometric and physiological checkup for work fitness, school admission, fitness clearance, or routine personal records.
services.description: A fast, accurate, and streamlined health assessment for patients needing an official fitness baseline, pre-employment checkup, or simple periodic health check. It covers essential physiological measurements with prompt documentation provided on request.
features: Height, weight, BMI, and vital biometric recording
Basic cardiovascular, respiratory, and musculoskeletal check
Blood pressure and oxygen saturation verification
Formal assessment summary report upon request

appointments.additionalMessage: Routine annual checkup, fasting blood sugar preferred.
